POSE295 R06 is an explicitly declared local differential-coordinate left-arm/garment pose adaptation. Original source hand/finger vertices are rigid anchor targets retained from the R03 hand-only pose; the rejected R03 body is not adopted. R06 adds actual fixed-leg roof support constraints on three complete original cuff profiles; every profile translates rigidly upward and elbowward from its real R04 shape without radial squeezing, and restores the broad neighboring folded cloth to the free differential domain. Bounded actual wrist/sleeve-root strict triangle contacts add small source-order-preserving physical layer-separation controls, with local neighbor propagation and original rest rebinds; inherited source pairs, microscopic residuals and hard-control conflicts are separately reported. This does not claim global intersection freedom. Source chest/rear/large upper sleeve/boundary controls stay fixed while the broad actual neighboring cloth/skin patch is solved in CPU Blender Laplacian Deform. Head/ears/scalp Y>=2.10, figure-right X<=0, legs Y<=.70, bearing/contact band, all original vertex/triangle/UV identities and CM07 mask remain exact from R08a. Actual body and left-arm/palm positions/normals are declared modified. No photograph, depth map, image plane, synthetic hand primitive, scene export or raster sampling is used. Original inputs, source ancestry, licenses and all failed candidates remain retained. Personal noncommercial CC BY-NC-SA4.0 adaptation only; no endorsement implied. SCULPT358 r06 declares additional original-source wrist/sleeve fairing and restrained original-palm/finger cupping on the same continuous indexed mesh. All original triangles, vertex identities, UVs, head/ears/scalp, figure-right hand, legs and bearing/contact band remain. No global intersection-free or photographic-match claim.
